what: Additive hysteresis CFAR (cfar.py --k 8 --k-grow 6) vs the shipped k=8 detector, scored against Global Fishing Watch SAR targets (public-global-sar-presence) inside the 40 km circle, 1 km match gate. GFW is an independent detector on the same scenes, not ground truth.

plain_hysteresis_k8_grow6.note: grows every blob, not only new ones: about 81% recall in scratch runs, but it fused 26 of the 250 v2 detections into oversized blobs (dropped by the 450 m cap or moved >100 m), so it loses targets the shipped detector finds

gate: recall vs GFW >= 0.80 and held-out ship-class precision >= v2
verdict: not adopted: recall 0.795 is under the gate, and 75 of the 79 added detections match no GFW target (mostly clutter). Shipped detector stays k=8; --k-grow is kept as an opt-in flag (default off, output identical to v2).
remaining_misses: about 12 of the 18 still-missed GFW targets are ships at berth in Khalifa Port, where the static sea mask marks the basin as land; about 5 are very faint (z < 6.5).
